plan.notes: Source: Cuyahoga Community College official 2026-2027 Catalog, 'Nursing, Associate of Applied Science' program page, 'Suggested Semester Sequence' (catalog.tri-c.edu). Catalog year is printed on the document. Credit sums verified: 15+15+13+13+5 = 61, matching the catalog's declared 'Total Credit Hours 61'. The 'Program Admissions Requirements Semester' is the catalog's own first block (prerequisite courses taken before program admission) and is transcribed as Semester 1. Catalog footnotes carried (not invented): students admitted to the Nursing program prior to Fall 2025 take NURS-2010 (Concepts of Nursing Care for Patients with Complex Conditions) instead of NURS-2011; a grade of B or higher is required in all science coursework for graduation; applicants must pass the HESI A2 and NURS-1000 before registering for NURS-1010. Students completing the first year are awarded a Certificate of Proficiency in Practical Nursing and may sit for the NCLEX-PN. Course codes normalized from catalog 'NURS-2011' style to 'NURS 2011'. No TCCNS in Ohio; transfer_confidence is empty.
